nodes.description: Address of the contract owner (Owned.owner), set in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending new owner address (Owned.newOwner) written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string for ISBToken.
Public token name string for ISBToken.
Public token decimals (uint8) for ISBToken.
Total token supply storage variable for ISBToken.
Mapping address => uint holding token balances of all accounts.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint holding ERC20 allowances.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
Owner-only function storing a pending newOwner address.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
Overflow-checked addition helper returning c = a + b.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper returning c = a - b.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper returning c = a * b.
Division helper with zero-divisor require, returning c = a / b.
ISBToken constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the deployer allocation.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets the allowance of spender over msg.sender tokens in the allowed mapping.
Spends an allowance and moves tokens from from to to using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender over tokenOwner tokens.
Sets an allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in a single transaction.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
Owner-only rescue function that triggers an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to the owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance accounting.
External call to an attacker-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval, executed after allowance state writes.
External call to an arbitrary token contract (ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer) controlled by the owner.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner, making authorization depend on the caller.
acceptOwnership checks msg.sender against newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances using balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the spender contract.
Owned constructor writes owner.
onlyOwner reads owner to validate the caller.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner, requires the caller to match it, then clears it.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
ISBToken constructor initializes symbol.
ISBToken constructor initializes name.
ISBToken constructor initializes decimals.
ISBToken constructor sets _totalSupply.
ISBToken constructor assigns the entire supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its subtraction.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits balances.
transferFrom decreases the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
safeAdd uses parameter a in the addition.
safeAdd uses parameter b in the addition.
safeSub uses parameter a as the minuend.
safeSub uses parameter b as the subtrahend.
safeMul uses parameter a as a factor.
safeMul uses parameter b as a factor.
safeDiv uses parameter a as the dividend.
safeDiv uses parameter b as the divisor.
balanceOf consumes its tokenOwner parameter.
transfer consumes its to parameter as the credit target.
transfer consumes its tokens parameter as the amount.
approve consumes its spender parameter.
approve consumes its tokens parameter as the allowance.
transferFrom consumes its from parameter as the debit source.
transferFrom consumes its to parameter as the credit target.
transferFrom consumes its tokens parameter as the amount.
allowance consumes its tokenOwner parameter.
allowance consumes its spender parameter.
approveAndCall consumes its spender parameter for both the allowance and the external call target.
approveAndCall consumes its tokens parameter.
approveAndCall forwards its data parameter to the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token consumes its tokenAddress parameter as an external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token consumes its tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
transferOwnership stores its _newOwner parameter into newOwner.
safeAdd assigns the computed sum to its return local c.
safeSub assigns the computed difference to its return local c.
safeMul assigns the computed product to its return local c.
safeDiv assigns the computed quotient to its return local c.
transfer returns the success flag after the balance updates.
approve returns the success flag after writing the allowance.
transferFrom returns the success flag after the balance and allowance updates.
approveAndCall returns the success flag after the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the boolean result of the external transfer.
balanceOf returns the balance local read from the balances mapping.
allowance returns the remaining local read from the allowed mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the source balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
onlyOwner modifier guards the execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards the execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
approveAndCall performs the unsafe external receiveApproval call after updating allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied token contract.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
The spender contract can reenter the token contract while approveAndCall holds control flow, enabling reentrancy.
The external token contract can reenter transferAnyERC20Token during the rescue call.
